name: pdfcn
summary: Copy-paste PDF components for React, shipped as a shadcn registry — document primitives, invoices, reports and theme presets.
description: A shadcn-format registry of PDF components for React, built on Takumi and Forme. It ships 79 items: document primitives (table, card, form, graph, QR code, signature, watermark, page number, key value …), pre-built blocks (invoices, financial, marketing, operations and security reports, gift certificate, packing slip, shipping label, meeting minutes …) and theme presets. Items install by namespace with the shadcn CLI; markdown mirrors, MCP support and an agent skill back LLM workflows.
contains: primitives: table, card, alert, badge, form, graph, list, footer and more
blocks: invoices, financial/marketing/security reports, gift certificate, packing slip, shipping label
9 theme presets: professional, modern, minimal, executive, corporate, elegant, vivid, forest, blueprint
installs with the shadcn CLI; MCP support; markdown mirrors and an agent skill
